4 امخّ It (a bone) was, or became, marrowy; had, or contained, marrow in it. (S, K.) ―
-b2- It (a camel, S, L, and a sheep or goat, L, K) became fat: (S, L, K:) or became in the first stage of fatness; or in the last stage when becoming lean. (L.) ―
-b3- امخّ (tropical:) It (a branch, or twig,) became sappy, and succulent. (L, K.) ―
-b4- (tropical:) It (standing corn, K, or its grain, L) became supplied with the farinaceous substance. (L, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
